title: Exactness of canonical flat scalar realization
statement: In the setting of [def-sfb-flat-scalar-realization], if R is flat over the constant ring sheaf in the sense of [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], the specified realization functor F preserves finite limits and finite colimits.

proof.text: After forgetting module structure, extension is naturally tensor with the restricted target ring. Sheafify the sectionwise tensor symmetry to construct this natural isomorphism.
Flatness makes the latter tensor functor exact. Forgetting to abelian sheaves reflects finite limits and finite colimits, so extension is exact. Compose with exact constant realization.
